name: Encrypted Files
tagline: Lock your private files behind your fingerprint
description:
Encrypted Files lets you protect any file or folder on your phone with strong AES-256 encryption. Unlocking them requires your fingerprint or face, so your private photos and documents stay safe even if someone else has your phone.

It's a simple, focused vault app: no accounts, no cloud, just your files kept safely under your own lock and key.
